newsitem.title: USA: Child's swimming vest recalled for safety concerns.
newsitem.headline: Child's swimming vest recalled for safety concerns.

text.p: The Consumer Product Safety Commission Monday said OddzOn Products Inc of Campbell, California is recalling about 5,000 children's swimming vests manufactured in 1996 and sold under the "Starfish" brand name.
The vest's buckles can unlatch unexpectedly while in use, releasing the child into the water, the federal agency said.
OddzOn Products had received one report of the buckles unlatching, but no injuries have been reported, it said.

The "Starfish" inflatable plastic swimming vest has a blue inner lining and collar and a yellow and pink body secured by two plastic buckles in the front. The vest was intended for children between 1 and 8 years old.
Consumers should return the vests to the store where purchased for a full refund. For more information, consumers can call OddzOn Products at 800-755-6674 or the CPSC's webset at http://www.cpsc.gov.
